controlling_replacement: Let R be a complete DVR of characteristic zero, and let a faithful cyclic group of order q act continuously by R-algebra automorphisms on R[[Z]]. If the action fixes Z = 0, the derivative of a generator is a primitive qth root of unity in R. The conclusion also holds for an R-valued fixed section Z = b with b in the maximal ideal of R, after the continuous R-algebra change of coordinate Z to Z - b.
mandatory_qualification: Complete coefficient DVR; faithful continuous R-linear action. Nonzero-section translation must not be applied over arbitrary noncomplete DVRs.
